name: myplex-watch-together
description: Self-hosted media server with ultra-precise Watch Together synchronization and universal format playback

scripts.dev:online: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run tunnel"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm --prefix desktop start"
